subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Pick up the slipped adjustable wrench lying across the left toolbox handle and place it flat in its matching wrench recess without disturbing the hammer.
Pick up the yellow-and-black pliers from the right side of the table and place them flat in the matching pliers recess in the toolbox.
Pick up the yellow tape measure to the right of the pliers and seat it flat in the matching compact tape measure recess in the toolbox.
Regrasp the yellow tape measure resting on the toolbox divider and seat it flat in its matching recess.
Pick up the adjustable wrench lying diagonally across the left carry handle and seat it flat in the matching toolbox recess.
Pick up the pliers from the table on the right and place them flat in their matching toolbox recess.
Reseat the yellow tape measure fully in its matching toolbox recess, release it, and return both arms to their starting poses with grippers open.
Open both grippers fully and return both robot arms to their initial poses. Keep the tools and toolbox undisturbed.
